%% Calibration deck: every block type, and the floating blocks.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Blocks}
	\begin{columns}[t,onlytextwidth]
		\begin{column}{0.31\linewidth}
			\begin{block}{block}
				Neutral: a statement, long enough to wrap
			\end{block}
			\begin{definitionblock}{definitionblock}
				A definition
			\end{definitionblock}
		\end{column}
		\begin{column}{0.31\linewidth}
			\begin{exampleblock}{exampleblock}
				A worked example
			\end{exampleblock}
			\begin{alertblock}{alertblock}
				A caveat or a warning
			\end{alertblock}
		\end{column}
		\begin{column}{0.31\linewidth}
			\begin{infoblock}{infoblock}
				An aside
			\end{infoblock}
			\begin{referenceblock}{referenceblock}
				A reference or citation
			\end{referenceblock}
		\end{column}
	\end{columns}
	\par\smallskip
	\begin{SMFloatingBlock}{5cm}{Floating block}
		A block of a width of its own.
	\end{SMFloatingBlock}
	\hfill
	\begin{SMFloatingInfoBlock}{5cm}{Floating info block}
		Aligned at the right.
	\end{SMFloatingInfoBlock}
\end{standardframe}
